name: agentdca
description: Agent tools for Direct Coupling Analysis with adabmDCA.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze sequence alignments and DCA models.
interface.longDescription: Use adabmDCA 2.x through structured agent tools: preprocess and split alignments, train DCA models (bmDCA, eaDCA, edDCA, edgeDCA, PTT), score sequences, predict contacts, scan mutations, sample with diagnostics or steering, estimate entropy, and retrain with experimental feedback.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this DCA model and summarize its metadata.
Preprocess this alignment for DCA training.
Score these sequences with my DCA model.
